source_freeze: S05 freeze application source/rights/coverage before assigning test IDs; no independent labels used to acquire corpus or tune prompts
candidate_order: ascending SHA256(seed + newline + source_namespace + colon + native_id), raw ID stable; no outcome-based skipping
test_partition: group by immutable work/topic cluster before deterministic seeded assignment; do not split versions from same work between dev and test
answerable_rule: all gold evidence must be reachable in frozen scope/version/ACL; insufficient-evidence cases remain distinct
sealing: record actual IDs, full message scripts, evidence IDs/hash, declared answerability, expected event constraints, evaluator/config hashes in S05 sealed manifest; separate development/test access and retain failed slots
multiturn: complete ordered scripts including repeats, scope corrections, cancellation, timeouts and resume events; not a bag of independent utterances
denominators: all assigned original positions retained; partial/failed/not_run/affected are not replaced; same task repeats do not increase independent N

main_contract_success.numerator: main runs satisfying all applicable predeclared automatic contracts
main_contract_success.denominator: 300 assigned main runs including failed and not_run

family_contract_success.numerator: successful assigned main runs in family

critical_contracts.denominator: all applicable checks including fault fixtures

tool_correctness.numerator: rule-defined selected tools, arguments semantics and dependency order correct
tool_correctness.denominator: all rule-evaluable tool decisions; not-evaluable count reported separately

executed_arguments_schema.numerator: executed tool attempts schema-valid before execution

first_model_argument_validity.denominator: all first tool argument returns; repair does not erase failure

formal_delivery.denominator: 90 research attempt slots; answerable-subset also separately reported

recall_at_20.numerator: relevant unique works in 20 unique paper results per query
recall_at_20.denominator: all native qrels for that query; macro over597; unreachable corpus => not_run

cost.numerator: sum all actual settled + unresolved reserved upper-bound fees including failed/review calls
cost.denominator: report per attempt, automatic contract success and complete formal delivery separately

latency.numerator: request to first sentence/full response; task active union, queue, waiting and end-to-end separately
latency.denominator: all assigned samples; successful p95 and failures both shown

cold.claim: process/collection readiness only; host disk cache uncontrolled

performance_matrix.double_generation: same fixed mixed schedule plus pinned old/new generation; measure memory/disk high water, reencode duration and publication lag; do not promise zero downtime

human.sample_selection: S05 lock concrete IDs by seed; S15 pre-run manifest freezes first repetition of3 proposal and6 short outputs; failure keeps its position; high risk severity then stable hash order
human.scope: finite fact/evidence checks only; not full report reading or expert academic validation
